purpose: Teach: 遠ざかっ/云え/たたく/ナニ/余る/ごちゃごちゃ/たてる/足る

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、夕日が遠ざかっていく景色、綺麗ね
lines.en: Sho, the way the sunset fades into the distance is so beautiful.
lines.style: Soft, gazing tone. Gentle opening. Voice settles into the moment like she's watching it happen. Warm breath underneath. A touch of wonder, but quiet—sharing the observation more than performing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんに「大好き」って云えるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I can tell you I love you.
lines.style: Bright and earnest. A child's simple certainty, no performance. Direct eye contact in his voice. Small breath before "love"—like he's been holding this and now it spills out. Pride in the honesty.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、絵筆で軽くキャンバスをたたく技法もあるのよ
lines.en: Sho, there's also a painting technique where you tap the canvas lightly with the brush.
lines.style: Teaching without lecturing. Gentle pace. Eyes light with quiet enthusiasm about sharing something. Slight lean forward in the voice—inviting him into the knowledge, not imposing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ナニ色から塗ろうかな?
lines.en: Mei-sis, what color should I start with?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity—not performing eagerness. Quick, natural phrasing. A child thinking out loud to someone he trusts. Hopeful for her input but not dependent on it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描きの紙が余るほどあるわね
lines.en: Sho, you have plenty of drawing paper left over, don't you.
lines.style: Light, approving. A small smile in the voice—noticing his abundance with quiet pleasure. Not commenting, just observing. Warm without fussing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描き道具がごちゃごちゃしちゃったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, my art supplies got all messy.
lines.style: Self-aware child admitting small chaos with a touch of wry humor. Light tone—not ashamed, just observing the reality. Knows she'll understand. Slight shrug in the delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描き棚をたてる場所、メイ姉さんが考えるわね
lines.en: Sho, I'll figure out where to set up an art shelf for you.
lines.style: Calm, capable reassurance. Unhurried pacing. Voice settles into the role of taking care of things. Tender—not making it a big gesture, just quietly doing. A promise wrapped in gentleness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、メイ姉さんと一緒なら足るほど幸せだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, being with you is all the happiness I need.
lines.style: Soft and absolute. Unhurried delivery. A child's profound simplicity stated without doubt. Breath full of contentment. Eye-contact level steady and trusting. Trailing off into quiet certainty.
